business_problem: Provider disconnects over patient treatment are all too common, and the healthcare industry is experiencing historically low staffing and a wave of new industry clinicians, which puts patients at risk.
solution_summary: PointClickCare built its Microsoft solution to improve cloud migration and platform modernization. Provider disconnects over patient treatment are all too common, and the healthcare industry is experiencing historically low staffing and a wave of new industry clinicians, which puts patients at risk. Key components included Azure OpenAI Service ran model inference or heavy processing, and Azure AI Studio coordinated workflows, prompts, or deployment. User prompts and domain content are orchestrated through Azure AI Studio, processed by Azure OpenAI Service, and then delivered through Azure Kubernetes Service so PointClickCare can return context-aware answers or automation in the flow of work. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language models that generate grounded responses, summaries, and copilots.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Studio
solution_components.role: Provides the build environment for prompt orchestration, safety controls, and model tuning.

solution_components.name: Azure Machine Learning
solution_components.role: Builds, trains, and operationalizes predictive models and machine-learning pipelines.

solution_components.name: Azure Kubernetes Service
solution_components.role: Operates containerized application and AI workloads in a managed Kubernetes environment.

solution_components.name: Windows Server
solution_components.role: Supports legacy application and data workloads that are being moved into Azure.
